text:
sarah-peopleops: flagging a data issue: a hiring committee export created this morning included candidate contact fields even though the 'redact candidate PII' toggle was ON in the UI. multiple hiring managers have the file.

ben-recruiter: oh no. which export? committee-packet for eng-sr-backend?

sarah-peopleops: yes. job id 6754. I downloaded the CSV and found columns: candidate_email,candidate_phone present. we expect those removed when redact=true.

export-bot: automated note: export job 2028-04-22-08-40-12 completed (job: committee-export, template: committee-v2, redact:true)

ben-recruiter: can you paste a sanitized row?

sarah-peopleops: sanitized header + sample row (sanitized):
```
candidate_id,candidate_name,candidate_email,candidate_phone,score_overview
6754-abc,REDACTED,rebecca@example.com,555-3333,"Strong system design"
```

greg-qa: repro: I ran export locally with redact flag true and saw same output. Debugging notes: the exporter uses two code paths: (A) api-export service which applies redaction, (B) legacy-export that runs for committee packets >50 pages. It looks like committee export fell into legacy-export which ignores redact param.

lina-security: tagging me as well. This is sensitive. How many files/people? We need containment steps.

ben-recruiter: I already emailed the 4 managers who received it asking them to delete the file and not share. But we need broader mitigation and to know if we sent to external addresses.

tom-eng: I'm on it. Immediate plan: (1) kill any in-flight exports by pausing the legacy-export queue, (2) rotate pre-signed S3 links for jobs created in the last 12 hours, (3) run a query for exports with redact=true that used legacy-export path to enumerate recipients.

lina-security: add a blocker: preserve copies of the files for forensic review before deletion by anyone. We need to know exact recipients and whether files left our org.

sarah-peopleops: noted. I'll coordinate with the managers and ask them to confirm deletion after we snapshot the file.

tom-eng: root cause: legacy-export service still defaults redact=false because we added the redact param to api-export only. quick fix options: (A) add redaction to legacy-export (hotfix), (B) forward legacy outputs through redactor service before upload. I'll ship (B) as it's lower risk and we can enable quickly as a middleware.

greg-qa: tests: I'll create integration test that runs both export paths with redact=true and asserts candidate_email/phone absent. Also add regression test to CI that fails on any csv containing /@.+\..+/ if redact flag set.

lina-security: timeline/SLAs: we need hotfix within 4 hours and full rollout + audit within 24 hours. Also notify legal and privacy. I'll open an internal incident and add required stakeholders.

tom-eng: ETA: middleware redactor + queue pause + snapshot script in ~3h. Then we'll re-run exports after redaction enabled. I'll post the PR.

ben-recruiter: for candidate-facing comms, do we need to notify candidates? Legal privacy to advise, but I want to know scope first.

lina-security: I'll coordinate with legal. If exports stayed internal and managers confirm deletion, it might be a limited incident. If any external email delivered we have to notify. We'll know after enumeration.

sarah-peopleops: asking managers to ack in the thread once they've deleted copies; I'll keep a running list in the incident doc.

tom-eng: telemetry: adding event export.generated with job_id, path_variant (legacy|api), redact_flag, recipients_count. Also adding alert if redact=true but path_variant=legacy.

greg-qa: I'll validate after hotfix and run a smoke against last 48h exports.

export-bot: automated note: legacy-export queue paused at 2028000030 by tom-eng.

lina-security: thanks. please also add a temporary UI banner for admins: "Exports with redaction may be delayed during incident handling" so recruiters don't retry and create more copies.

ben-recruiter: posting to #hiring-managers: short note + ask to delete and await follow-up.

sarah-peopleops: thanks team. keep the thread updated and drop the PR link when ready.
